meta.status_note: SAMPLE values for building the interface. Not real scores.

sites.name: Umm Jirsan lava tube
sites.facts: Longest reported lava tube in Arabia: 1481 m; passages 8-12 m high, up to 45 m wide; three segments split by two roof collapses
sites.access_note: Main collapse entrance walled with a staircase since 2017
sites.region: Harrat Khaybar ~125 km N of Madinah

sites.name: Harrat Khaybar (summit area)
sites.facts: Basaltic field built over ~5 million years; summit 2093 m; cones incl. Jabal Abyad and Jabal Bayda
sites.access_note: Large field; roads reach oasis edges
sites.region: NW Saudi Arabia N of Madinah

sites.name: Al Wahbah crater
sites.facts: ~2 km wide, ~250 m deep; white salt-crust floor; steep walls
sites.access_note: About 2 h drive from Taif airport via highway and paved roads

sites.name: Harrat Rahat
sites.facts: Largest lava field in Saudi Arabia (~20,000 km2); 900+ vents in the north; last eruption 1256 CE

sites.name: Harrat Uwayrid
sites.facts: ~7150 km2 basalt plateau with younger cinder cones; up to 1920 m

sites.name: Wabar impact craters
sites.analog_for: True impact site / dust and dunes
sites.facts: Confirmed impact craters; largest ~116 m; impact glass; meteorite fragments
sites.access_note: Deep desert - hardest access on the list

sites.name: Ghar Al Hibashi lava tube
sites.facts: Surveyed lava tube (length reported as 689.5 m and 581 m in different sources); richest cave-mineral site in Saudi Arabia
sites.region: Harrat Nawasif/Al Buqum ~245 km SE of Makkah

sites.name: Harrat Lunayyir
sites.facts: Basaltic volcanic field; site of a 2009 earthquake swarm linked to a dike intrusion
sites.access_note: Inland from Umluj on the Red Sea coast

sites.name: Harrat Kishb
sites.facts: Basaltic field with scoria cones, tuff rings and maars; contains Al Wahbah crater
